FORECLOSURE SALES NOTICE


By order of the Commissioners Court for Fort Bend County, Texas, the
designation of the location for the foreclosure sales has been changed.
beginning December 2, 202~, pursuant to Section 51.002(h) of the
Texas Property Code and Section 24.0l(r) of the Texas Tax Code. The
sales shall be held at the following location:



              Gus George Law Enforcement Academy -

                                  Patton Hall

                      1S21 Eugene Heimann Circle

                         Richmond, Texas 77469

         Between the hours of 10:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M.



To view the order, please visit the Fort Bend County website and search
      Official Public Records for instrument number 2025082537.




    The County Clerk's office is not involved with the sales. The clerks are not .
                  attorneys and will not give any legal advice.
                        NOTICE
As a courtesy, thisforeclosure list is images and available to the
public. Foreclosure sales take place the first Tuesday of each
month.

HB 1128 amended Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code
§34.01, Property Code § and Tax Code §34.0i' to move the
public sale to the first Wednesday of the month if the first
Tuesday of the month occurs on Janua~y 1 or July 4.
Since the cut-off date will vary monthly, this list will be
available to the public on or before the 20th of each month for
the upcoming date of sale.


Properties sold by Fort Bend County are found on:
The delinquent tax attorney's website at www.lgbs.com.


For information regarding all tax foreclosure sales visit:
Fort Bend County Constables1 individual websites.

                   FORECLOSURE NOTICES AND SALES
1.        Foreclosure Notices are filed with the county clerk's office 21 days prior to the
          foreclosure sale date.

2.        Foreclosure sales are held at the Fort Bend County Gus George Law
          Enforcement Academy, Patton Hall, 1521 Eugene Heimann Circle,
          Richmond, TX 77 469 between the hours of 10 a.m. and 4 p.m. on the first
          Tuesday of each month. HB 1128 amended Texas Civil Practice and
          Remedies Code §34.01, Property Code §51.002, and Tax Code §34.01 to
          move the public sale to the first Wednesday of the month, if the first Tuesday
          of the month occurs on January 1 or July 4.
